lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to buy a linen loincloth and wear it, and Jeremiah does.
Jeremiah takes the loincloth to Perath and hides it in a crevice of the rocks, as commanded.
Many days later, Jeremiah digs up the loincloth at the Euphrates, and it is ruined and of no use.
The LORD says He will ruin the pride of Judah and Jerusalem, because they did not listen to Him.
The LORD says He will fill the people with drunkenness, sparing the kings and priests, and smash fathers and sons together.

wrong_details.true: the kings who sit on David's throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the people are filled with drunkenness
